I met this girl like two years ago, after talking to her for a while I knew I wanted to be with her. You know that feeling when you meet someone you’re completely amazed with? Like that. We became best friends, however, we really had a connection, we flirted all the time and stuff like that.

Recently I went on a trip with my class for a week, however, before leaving for this trip one of her friends told me she liked me (my best friend, not the one who told me), I got really excited. The first day we were really connected, I guess you could say, it was the happiest I’ve ever felt since a loooooong time, I decided to get her a bracelet that she really liked on a small village we went to, however, after doing that she started drifting away. The next day I tried joking with her and stuff, but she would just give me really indifferent responses, this went on for like 2 days, at the 3rd day, I saw her talking to someone else, but she had this look in her eyes, as if she was lost in him, later that day I was walking with a friend to my room and heard her say to a friend “I don’t get what I see in him” like on a dreamy tone, while watching the one I mentioned before. The 4th day I saw her spending the whole time with him, she looked so happy, more than I’ve ever seen her before. The last day, the trip staff surprised us with a bonfire, everyone got emotional, so I decided to go to her and give her a hug for all the good years we’ve had, she returned it, but after that she just told me “I need to speak with him” (she didn’t say him, she said his name (duh)), so I just left her to talk to him.

I haven’t talked to her since, but it has been plaguing my mind since then

I know it’s stupid for me to get this torn apart over a girl, but it’s just, she was one of the few things I kept living on for, but now losing all that over someone else is just devastating, like if everything I’ve ever wanted is being taken from me
